name: SP-GVAE: structure-preserving GraphVAE
tagline: GCN-VAE with size-conditioned decoder, triangle-weighted BCE, degree-matching MSE, and a hybrid empirical-aggregate-posterior latent prior at sampling time.

key_hyperparams.name: fit_emp_split
key_hyperparams.role: fitted-Gaussian vs per-point empirical sampling mix

init_recovers: Vanilla GraphVAE baseline at all auxiliary weights = 0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the GraphVAE baseline's plain BCE+KL with triangle-weighted, degree-conditioned reconstruction, a node-count-conditioned decoder, and a hybrid empirical-aggregate-posterior sampler (instead of a unit Gaussian).

name: AAE-Graph (adversarial GAE)
tagline: GCN-encoder graph autoencoder with inner-product edge decoding and a Wasserstein-style discriminator that aligns the encoder's latent to a Gaussian prior.
diff_from_baseline: Swaps the GraphVAE baseline's KL-regularized prior for an adversarial autoencoder (separate encoder/decoder + discriminator optimisers), and replaces the dense MLP edge decoder with an inner-product over generated node embeddings.

name: Linear-flow-matching graph transformer
tagline: 5-layer node+edge graph transformer trained as a linear flow-matching denoiser between Gaussian noise and the clean adjacency, sampled with 100 Euler steps.
diff_from_baseline: A custom flow-matching graph generator that replaces the GraphVAE/GRAN/DiGress baselines: a node+edge graph transformer is trained on linear interpolations between Gaussian noise and clean adjacencies, then 100-step Euler integrated at inference time.

name: Latent graphon VAE + moment matching
tagline: Low-rank role-mixture decoder (memberships * symmetric KxK role matrix) trained with masked BCE plus differentiable moment matching on degree, 2-stars and triangles, sampled from the empirical aggregated posterior.
formula: $$\hat{p}_{ij}(z) = \sigma\!\left(\sum_{k,l} M_{ik}(z)\,R_{kl}\,M_{jl}(z) + b(z)\right),\quad \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{BCE} + 0.7\,\mathrm{CE}_{n} + 0.8\,\sum_{m\in\{\rho,\bar d, S_2, T\}} |m_{\hat A}-m_A| + 0.01\,\mathrm{KL} - 0.02\,H$$

key_hyperparams.name: post_jitter
key_hyperparams.role: noise std added to cached posterior at sampling

init_recovers: GraphVAE baseline when role matrix is rank-1 and moment_w = count_w = 0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the GraphVAE baseline's full MxN^2 dense decoder with a low-rank graphon-style decoder (memberships + symmetric role matrix), adds explicit node-count classification, differentiable structural-moment matching, entropy regularization, and aggregated-posterior sampling.

name: Spectral-conditioned discrete diffusion
tagline: 100-step discrete edge-flip diffusion with cosine schedule; denoiser is a graph transformer conditioned on Laplacian eigenvalues plus structural-regularization losses on degree and clustering.

key_hyperparams.name: importance_scale
key_hyperparams.role: extra flip-prob multiplier on high-degree edges

init_recovers: DiGress-style discrete diffusion baseline when spectral conditioning and degree-aware corruption are disabled
diff_from_baseline: Builds on the DiGress baseline's edge-flip diffusion, but conditions the denoiser on Laplacian eigenvalues, weights the flip distribution by degree-product importance, and adds explicit MSE regularizers on predicted degree and clustering.
